summary: The Dashboard web service provides methods for retrieving cost centre records based on user authentication. Primary functions include handling user login, parsing parameters for filtering records, and managing sessions.
purpose: To manage user sessions and retrieve lists of cost centre records for specified parameters using web services.

workflows.name: Cost Centre Retrieval
steps: Retrieve cost centre records based on session and parameters.

business_rules: Use sessionID for authenticated user actions.
conditions: Check if sessionID > 0 to confirm successful login.
system_behavior: Handles successful and unsuccessful user login.
Provides cost centre record retrieval functionality.
dependencies: Data access layers like HSPnet.DataLayer for retrieving cost centre records.

summary: The StudentPlacementSelector control manages the display and interaction of placement requests for students, including filtering options and selection preferences.
purpose: To allow students and staff to view and manage placement requests using a web UI control.

workflows.name: Placement Request Management
steps: Configure view settings based on user role.
Bind data to dropdowns and grids.
Manage user interactions for adding/removing preferences.

business_rules: Lock presentation for staff viewing student data.
validations: JavaScript validation for special considerations input.
conditions: Check if placement request is open or closed.
Determine visibility of UI elements based on user role and status.
system_behavior: Handles locking and unlocking of controls based on user session.
dependencies: Uses HSPnet.DataLayer for backend data retrieval.
exceptions: Hide elements if session is locked for staff.
